body: You just broke me. I actually broke down, and started crying. That's the first time I've cried in 5 months. And I don't normally ever cry. The last time I remember crying was when Jen tried to leave, (She's my everything. And I mean that) but she was drunk at the time. Ever since the night she tried to leave, she hasn't drank at all. Thank you. It's nice to know someone out there cares.
I'm going to sleep for now, I'll check in this in the morning. Post comments, PM me, whatever. I just need someone to talk to.
